Sir,

Reference to your letter of December 19,
1940, on the subject of the woman with whom
Mr. Mallet is living, I enclose a copy of a
Police report containing what information
is available to S.M. Police respecting this
woman.

Yours faithfully,

(Signed) J. BENNETT
Assistant Commissioner
(Special Branch)

SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SPECIAL BRANCH D.I. Supply
〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写批注〕
Date Jan. 15th, 1941

REPORT

Subject MRS. J. MALLET - ADDRESS OF.

Made by D.J.I. Maklaevsky Forwarded by D.I. Crawford.

A lady, who gives her name as Mrs. J. Mallet, lives
in the Flat lately occupied by Mr. J. Mallet at
159/12 Seymour Road.

It is not known whether she is his legal wife or
that they just lived together and her maiden name or
nationality is not known.

Mr. J. Mallet left Shanghai for Singapore on
December 26th., 1940.

〔此处转录不清：左侧手写符号 C 3/4 及右侧签名 D.S.I.〕

A.C. (SPECIAL BRANCH).

特别处 侦探督察 供应

日期：1941年1月15日

报告

事由：J. 马莱夫人——住址。

制作人：D.J.I. 马克拉耶夫斯基 转呈人：D.I. 克劳福德。

一位自称 J. 马莱夫人的女士，居住在西摩路159号12室，该公寓此前由 J. 马莱先生居住。

目前尚不清楚她是否为马莱先生的合法妻子，抑或二人仅为同居关系；其婚前姓名及国籍均不详。

J. 马莱先生已于1940年12月26日离开上海前往新加坡。

〔此处转录不清：左侧手写符号 C 3/4 及右侧签名 D.S.I.〕

助理总监（特别处）。
